description: React component for the Activity page which displays recent activity fetched from API and listens for real-time updates via WebSocket. It includes a data table, pagination, and socket connection status indicator.

methods.name: Activity()
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the activity page, managing state, fetch, websocket subscriptions, and UI rendering.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches activity data from backend API and updates the state, resetting the pagination to first page.

methods.name: normalizeRealtime
methods.description: Converts incoming realtime WebSocket payloads into activity row format.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page in pagination if possible.

methods.name: prevPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page in pagination if possible.
